fields.equipment: The name of the industrial asset or piece of equipment.
fields.tag: The unique identifier or tag number of the equipment or instrument.
fields.parameter: The physical property or measurement being monitored.
fields.unit: The unit of measurement for the parameter.
fields.action_remarks: Narrative description of the trigger condition and the resulting action.
fields.condition: The specific state or event that triggers a rule or action.
fields.action: The required response or automatic result triggered by a condition.
fields.requirement: A mandatory instruction or constraint that must be met.
fields.biogas_quality_interlock: Specific interlock conditions related to biogas quality.
fields.alarm: The description or name of the alarm event.
fields.alarm_designation: The criticality or importance level of the alarm.
fields.flare_area_exclusion: Identifier for the flare area exclusion zone.
fields.examples: Illustrative examples of the rule or limit.
fields.probes: The specific probes involved in the measurement.
fields.log_entry: The text to be recorded in the system log.
fields.zero_drift_limit: The allowable limit for zero drift.
fields.span_drift_limit: The allowable limit for span drift.
fields.interval: The time-based or usage-based interval for a task.
fields.reminder: The notification issued to remind personnel of a deadline.
fields.frequency: How often a task must be performed.
fields.classification: The category or type of area or equipment (e.g., confined space).
fields.testing_window: The time frame during which testing must occur.
fields.ch4_limit: The safety limit for methane concentration.
fields.h2s_limit: The safety limit for hydrogen sulfide concentration.
fields.o2_limit: The safety limit for oxygen concentration.
fields.entry_supervisor_duty: The specific responsibility of the entry supervisor.
fields.acknowledgment_requirement: The requirement for a supervisor to acknowledge an action.
fields.restriction: Prohibitions or limitations on access or activity.
fields.exclusion_zone: The physical dimensions or definition of an exclusion zone.
fields.personnel_entry: The conditions under which personnel are permitted to enter.

categories.OperatingLimit: Limits defining safe or standard operation.
categories.AutomaticReaction: System responses triggered automatically by conditions.
categories.RecurringDuty: Tasks that must be performed on a regular schedule.
categories.MaintenanceTrigger: Events that initiate a maintenance requirement.
categories.AccessRestriction: Constraints on who can enter or access an area.
categories.AccessRequirement: Prerequisites that must be met for entry.
categories.StartInterlock: Conditions that must be met before equipment can start.
categories.ExclusionZoneLimit: Limits defining the boundaries of an exclusion zone.
